decision_rule: Full CPU build qualification only: exact v10 base and source diff plus all generated header hashes; linked llama-server contains adaptive environment, durable journal schema and poison markers; GGML_HIP OFF and backend DL OFF; hash-bound llama/ggml libraries resolve locally. Stop on validated full receipt; futility on build, identity or linkage failure, STOP or deadline. Smoke compiles actual transformed server translation unit and checks markers; no model, identity, speed or P9 verdict. Replacement v1 supervisor must record command exit reason and verified drain; full-build markers must be in the hash-bound local libllama-server-impl.so, with executable/cache/linkage bound and both UI build/fetch disabled.
